n = len(target)
print(f"Length: {n}")

# Parse pairings

pairs = {}
for i, c in enumerate(target):
    if c == '(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c == ')':
        j = stack.pop()
        pairs[j] = i
        pairs[i] = j

# Build sequence: strong G-C pairs, A for unpaired
seq = ['A'] * n
for i in range(n):
    if i in pairs:
        j = pairs[i]
        if i < j:
            # Alternate G-C and C-G for diversity, avoid long GC runs
            if (i // 2) % 2 == 0:
                seq[i] = 'G'
                seq[j] = 'C'
            else:
                seq[i] = 'C'

# For hairpin loops (10-nt), use the recommended caps

        pos = start + k
        if pos <= end:

result = ''.join(seq)

print(f"Sequence: {result}")

target = ".....((((((((...((((((((((..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..))))))))))...((((((((((..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..))))))))))...((((((((((..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..))))))))))...))))))))....."

n = len(target)

pairs = {}
for i, c in enumerate(target):
    if c == '(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c == ')':
        j = stack.pop()
        pairs[i] = j
        pairs[j] = i

seq = ['A'] * n

# Get all paired regions
# Find stem segments
stems = []
i = 0
while i < n:
    if i in pairs and pairs[i] > i:
        j = i
        while j < n and j in pairs and pairs[j] > j:
            j += 1
        stems.append((i, j-1))
        i = j
    else:
        i += 1

print("Stems (start, end on 5' side):")
for s in stems:
    length = s[1] - s[0] + 1
    print(f"  [{s[0]}, {s[1]}] len={length} -> pairs with [{pairs[s[1]]}, {pairs[s[0]]}]")

# stem[0]: outer 8-bp: [5,12]
# stem[1]: module 1 10-bp: [16,25]
# stem[2]: module 1 hairpin 1, 4-bp: [28,31]
# stem[3]: module 1 hairpin 2, 4-bp: [48,51]
# stem[4]: module 1 hairpin 3, 4-bp: [68,71]
# stem[5]: module 2 10-bp: [101,110]
# stem[6]: module 2 hairpin 1, 4-bp: [113,116]
# stem[7]: module 2 hairpin 2, 4-bp: [133,136]
# stem[8]: module 2 hairpin 3, 4-bp: [153,156]
# stem[9]: module 3 10-bp: [186,195]

# stem[11]: module 3 hairpin 2, 4-bp: [218,221]
# stem[12]: module 3 hairpin 3, 4-bp: [238,241]

# Strategy: assign UNIQUE sequence motifs to each stem so they ONLY pair with their intended partners
# Use diverse sequences with controlled complementarity

def assign_pair(seq, i5, j5, top_seq):
    """Assign top_seq to the 5' strand, reverse complement to the 3' strand."""
    comp = {'A': 'U', 'U': 'A', 'G': 'C', 'C': 'G'}
    bot_seq = ''.join(comp[b] for b in reversed(top_seq))
    for k, b in enumerate(top_seq):
        seq[i5 + k] = b
    j3 = pairs[i5 + len(top_seq) - 1]
    for k, b in enumerate(bot_seq):
        seq[j3 - k] = b

# Outer 8-bp stem (strong, GC-rich)
assign_pair(seq, 5, 278, "GCGCGCGC")  # 8 bp, all G-C

# Module 1 (positions 16-25 / 88-97, then 3 hairpins)
assign_pair(seq, 16, 97, "GCGCAAUGCG")  # 10 bp
assign_pair(seq, 28, 45, "GGAC")   # hairpin 1.1
assign_pair(seq, 48, 65, "CCAG")   # hairpin 1.2
assign_pair(seq, 68, 85, "GCAA")   # hairpin 1.3

# Module 2 (positions 101-110 / 173-182)
assign_pair(seq, 101, 182, "CGCGUUACGC")  # 10 bp (different from mod 1)
assign_pair(seq, 113, 130, "CGUA")  # hairpin 2.1
assign_pair(seq, 133, 150, "AUGC")  # hairpin 2.2
assign_pair(seq, 153, 170, "UACG")  # hairpin 2.3

# Module 3 (positions 186-195 / 258-267)
assign_pair(seq, 186, 267, "AUAUCGAUAU")  # 10 bp (different from mod 1,2)
assign_pair(seq, 198, 215, "AGCU")  # hairpin 3.1
assign_pair(seq, 218, 235, "GCAU")  # hairpin 3.2
assign_pair(seq, 238, 255, "UCGA")  # hairpin 3.3

# Hairpin loops (10-nt each): use A-rich loops for stability
loops_10 = [
    [32, 41], [52, 61], [72, 81],
    [117, 126], [137, 146], [157, 166],
    [202, 211], [222, 231], [242, 251]
]
# Use slightly varied loop sequences
loop_seqs = [
    "GAAAGAAAGA", "GAAAUAAAGA", "GAAAAAAAGA",
    "GAAAGAAAGA", "GAAAUAAAGA", "GAAAAAAAGA",
    "GAAAGAAAGA", "GAAAUAAAGA", "GAAAAAAAGA",
]
for (start, end), ls in zip(loops_10, loop_seqs):
    for k, b in enumerate(ls):
        seq[start + k] = b

# Unpaired linkers: keep as A or U for flexibility
# All other positions are already 'A'

result = ''.join(seq)
print(f"\nSequence ({len(result)} nt):")
print(result)

# Verify all paired positions are complementary
comp = {'A': 'U', 'U': 'A', 'G': 'C', 'C': 'G', 'N': 'N'}
all_ok = True
for i, j in pairs.items():
    if comp.get(result[i], 'X') != result[j]:
        print(f"MISMATCH at ({i},{j}): {result[i]} vs {result[j]}")
        all_ok = False
print(f"All pairs complementary: {all_ok}")

target = ".....((((((((...((((((((((..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..))))))))))...((((((((((..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..))))))))))...((((((((((..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..))))))))))...))))))))....."

n = len(target)
assert n == 284

# Parse pairings
stack = []
pairs = {}
for i, c in enumerate(target):
    if c == '(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c == ')':
        j = stack.pop()
        pairs[i] = j
        pairs[j] = i

seq = ['A'] * n
comp = {'A': 'U', 'U': 'A', 'G': 'C', 'C': 'G'}

def assign_stem(seq, i5, top_seq):
    """Assign top_seq to 5' strand, reverse-complement to 3' strand."""
    L = len(top_seq)
    j3 = pairs[i5 + L - 1]  # leftmost 3' position
    bot_seq = ''.join(comp[b] for b in reversed(top_seq))
    for k in range(L):
        seq[i5 + k] = top_seq[k]
        seq[j3 + k] = bot_seq[k]

# Outer 8-bp stem
assign_stem(seq, 5, "GCGCGCGC")

# 9 unique 4-bp hairpin stems
stem4 = ["GGAC", "GCCA", "GAUC", "CGUA", "AGCU", "CUGG", "UACG", "UCGA", "CGAU"]

# 3 unique 10-bp stems  
stem10 = ["GCGCAAUGCG", "CGCGUUACGC", "GCAUCGAUGC"]

# Module 1
assign_stem(seq, 16, stem10[0])
assign_stem(seq, 28, stem4[0])
assign_stem(seq, 48, stem4[1])
assign_stem(seq, 68, stem4[2])

# Module 2
assign_stem(seq, 101, stem10[1])
assign_stem(seq, 113, stem4[3])
assign_stem(seq, 133, stem4[4])
assign_stem(seq, 153, stem4[5])

# Module 3
assign_stem(seq, 186, stem10[2])
assign_stem(seq, 198, stem4[6])
assign_stem(seq, 218, stem4[7])
assign_stem(seq, 238, stem4[8])

# Hairpin loop caps (10-nt each)
loops_10 = [
    (32, 41), (52, 61), (72, 81),
    (117, 126), (137, 146), (157, 166),
    (202, 211), (222, 231), (242, 251)
]
loop_seqs = [
    "GAAAGAAAGA", "GAAAUAAAGA", "GAAAAAAAGA",
    "GAAAGAAAGA", "GAAAUAAAGA", "GAAAAAAAGA",
    "GAAAGAAAGA", "GAAAUAAAGA", "GAAAAAAAGA",
]
for (start, end), ls in zip(loops_10, loop_seqs):
    for k, b in enumerate(ls):
        seq[start + k] = b

result = ''.join(seq)
print(f"Length: {len(result)}")

# Verify complementarity
all_ok = True
for i, j in pairs.items():
    if comp.get(result[i], 'X') != result[j]:
        print(f"MISMATCH ({i},{j}): {result[i]}-{result[j]}")
        all_ok = False
print(f"All pairs complementary: {all_ok}")

print(f"Sequence: {result}")
PYEOF
